c8bcefee-c64a-5a1f-911c-502cc4522701.content: Link each HCI research question directly to corresponding user data and analysis procedures.

cc860653-ad91-52f8-91db-5b26371dca0a.content: Design the proposal’s primary evaluation as a usability study in a controlled environment.

af0d191d-d23e-562b-997b-b1024dacefda.content: If field operation approval cannot be obtained within the master’s research period, leave actual deployment to subsequent studies.

8747b27e-6c2b-5498-9eac-c403e26101a6.content: In preregistered studies, specify the conditions under which deviations from the plan are permissible.

c3ad4ad8-4c5c-54c5-8d65-2dae15fa69a0.content: In preregistered studies, specify how to record content that deviates from the plan.

df53a41c-2fbf-532a-a5b0-560a196bf5cb.content: Present the target number of participants in the recruitment plan as a single precise value.

24d49198-fd7b-5810-bc56-1910a796f76e.content: Specify the interview protocols, recording devices, or log tools used to collect each type of user data.

2f367cf3-50c5-59bc-972e-6173e56343ac.content: Specify whether each type of user data is collected before, during, or after the interaction.

91db3bd1-4417-5db6-b7a6-3e79c87ebe88.content: The agent cannot assess the realism of a recruitment plan without seeing the expected attrition stages from initial contact to final participation.

49746579-92d7-51ea-b158-7d770443d101.content: In formative evaluation prototypes, implementation instability exists as an independent cause of task failure alongside design choices.

20d116ab-f9cc-5f61-808b-8555da09d707.content: If a prototype safety signal occurs during formative evaluation, existing institutional safety procedures take precedence over planned data collection.

881bc037-c099-50e4-b7e0-d38fba5146c9.content: Reviewers judge answerability by tracing the path from each research question to the data and analysis.

9a969676-6093-5fac-bda8-92ebdac70c37.content: The author of this proposal tends to present implemented feature lists directly as design contributions.

0ecc319a-ae60-5510-883d-52e613138164.content: In formative evaluation, compare alternatives that differ in only one core design attribute.

c4dfdb65-e673-52c0-a40c-e909d6014e00.content: When comparing design alternatives, keep participant tasks and provided information identical.

a7c3a123-3f05-52e0-b33e-c450d1a070ac.content: After each formative evaluation iteration, specify the decision rules for determining which evidence justifies modifying the next prototype.

13dc50e1-ecaa-504e-a602-7a10a09d5484.content: The author of this proposal tends to attempt evaluating all features of a prototype simultaneously in a single study.

358230d3-9ff0-51b9-9bf6-0752a2d9845a.content: When an evaluation assigns multiple design alternatives sequentially to one participant, later conditions occur after the participant has experienced earlier conditions.
